Behind the simulation MODEL & REFERENCES+

A teaching model, with the edges visible.

The scene uses a fixed subject, focus distance, and focal length. Captured light scales with exposure time ÷ f-number². Displayed brightness also scales with ISO relative to the reference settings. The meter shows the exact model ratio; the preview compresses its range so changes stay legible.

Depth blur, motion trails, and grain are illustrative. Grain depends on a simplified proxy for captured light and ISO: high ISO does not inevitably mean a noisier final image. Real results also depend on lighting, movement, sensor design, processing, diffraction, and focus distance. The cutaway is an explanatory diagram, not to scale; the shutter slit is symbolic.
